text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Co-operative Societies (Composition of Offences) Rules 2008 and shall come into operation on 15th December 2008.

2. Any offence (other than a continuing offence) under —
(a)section 16A(9), 16B(2), 34(9), 35(9), 65A(4), 93A(6), 97C(3), 99(2) or 100(1)(a), (b), (c), (d), (e), (f), (g) or (h) or (2) of the Act; or
[S 608/2019 wef 04/09/2019]
(b)[Deleted by S 608/2019 wef 04/09/2019]
(c)[Deleted by S 608/2019 wef 04/09/2019]
(d)rule 6(2), 7A(2) or 9(2) of the Co-operative Societies Rules 2009 (G.N. No. S 349/2009),
[S 350/2009 wef 01/08/2009]
[S 608/2019 wef 04/09/2019]
may be compounded by the Registrar in accordance with section 100F of the Act.
[S 608/2019 wef 04/09/2019]
